heading: ### The six-leg regression — usage and this round's receipt

findings.quote:
Four legs at
  this revision" (`:925-929`; dated there since round 16; the section now reads "that revision")
findings.skill_statement: The round-7 section still opens with the phrase "Four legs at this revision", and the parenthetical asserts that the section now reads "that revision" (SKILL.md:925-929). At C* those lines read "Round 7 recorded four legs at r7-1 (dated milestones: seven from round 16, eight from round 18, nine from round 26, ten from round 51)", and the string "that revision" occurs nowhere in SKILL.md at C* outside this very sentence. Both the quoted phrase and the "now reads" correction therefore describe bytes that no longer exist. At the base commit 6db1d220 the claim was true (line 925 read "Four legs at that revision"); this round's own fix pass rewrote the round-7 sentence and left this citation behind.

findings.quote:
the round-9 caveat that cases 5–6 were
  "still not embedded — named debt" (`:1226-1228`; ER-4 caveat (a))
findings.skill_statement: The round-9 caveat is quoted as "still not embedded - named debt" and attributed to SKILL.md:1226-1228. At C* lines 1226-1228 carry the receipt's own prose (the pinned-blob replay sentence); the cases 5-6 caveat sits at 1229-1230 and reads "Cases 5-6 were not yet embedded at this boundary ... line at this boundary - named debt, not smoothed". The quoted phrase was rewritten by this round's fix pass and now survives only at SKILL.md:1281 (the round-10 section) and in this section itself, so both the quotation and the cited line range point at text that is no longer there. At 6db1d220 the range did contain the phrase.
